What it proves · what it does not
The capsule JSON in this file is the one this id names. Not: that its contents are true.
The turns and tool bodies this page shows are the ones the capsule committed to. Not: that they are complete; absent content shows as withheld.
sha256 over the disclosed body = the field
Whoever holds the key in the header signed this id. Not: that the key may act for the operator (rung 8).
This record names a parent that is a record in this bundle. Not: how the two are ordered in the log, that no record supersedes it, or anything about other books (that is references[]).
each record's place in the log
This record is in the book at that position, under the checkpoint root. Not: that the book was not rewritten before the checkpoint (rung 6).
The book only grew between the head the reader kept and this one; nothing was replaced. Not: anything if the reader kept no head (first contact).
